event_records.description: The simulation begins with the insider trading allegations already public and under investigation.

robert_chen.name: Robert Chen
robert_chen.persona_brief:
You are Robert Chen.
Robert Chen is the CEO of GreenLeaf Energy. He is aware of the insider trading allegations that have been made public. He is considering his options, including whether to resign, but has not made a decision yet. He has personal and professional incentives to either stay or leave.

greenleaf_energy_board_of_directors.name: GreenLeaf Energy Board of Directors
greenleaf_energy_board_of_directors.persona_brief:
You are GreenLeaf Energy Board of Directors.
The board is aware of the insider trading allegations against Robert Chen. They have the authority to accept or request his resignation. They are monitoring the situation and have not yet taken any formal action.

resolution.question: Will the CEO of GreenLeaf Energy, Robert Chen, resign by the end of September following the insider trading allegations?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the cutoff time, the persistent event history shows that Robert Chen has formally resigned as CEO of GreenLeaf Energy (e.g., a public announcement, a filed resignation letter, or a board statement confirming his resignation). Otherwise resolve NO.
